More than lunch

From acknowledgement to presence.

Chelsea's Kitchen is an Algonquin-owned food company rooted in Kitigan Zibi Anishinabeg and serving Ottawa. We believe reconciliation is stronger when Algonquin people are not only acknowledged, but visible, working, creating and participating in the economy of our own traditional territory.

Any day during TRC Week, your lunch can be one small, direct way to support that presence.

Food starts conversations.
